audit.why: 47.39% over 1439 games — the hardest lane in this slice. Difficulty is pure range: Shocking Orb reaches 1050 and Eye of Destruction 1000 against Aurora's 900 Q and 700 W hop, so the first four levels are farm-and-absorb. It flips at 6 because Rite of the Arcane immobilises him while he fires.
audit.corrected: 7/10 retained; the difficulty is now expressed in the actual ranges rather than 'a distance your kit resents'.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike was described as diving 'before Rite of the Arcane can peel'. Rite of the Arcane does not peel — Riot's text is that Xerath immobilises himself and gains long-range barrages.
audit.why: That inverts the actual spike. His ultimate is the reason to go in: for its whole duration he is a stationary target, and the W hop plus the R leap reach him. Also, Shocking Orb barely scales down (13s to 11s), so the 'wait for his stun' window never gets much shorter.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, mid, late, breakdown.late and wants.you[2] rebuilt around the self-immobilise.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] read 'Land Eye of Destruction stuns'. Eye of Destruction (W) does not stun — it slows, with a stronger slow in the centre. The stun is Shocking Orb (E).
audit.why: Attributing his only hard CC to the wrong ability makes the whole dodge priority wrong: a player would sidestep the barrage and eat the orb. Correct interaction: W slows so that E can land, and E is the button that converts his poke into a kill.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[1] rewritten as W-slow-into-E-stun; breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t state which ability holds the stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere', and breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit.
audit.why: Defect item 3 plus the packet defect. Real numbers: Shocking Orb 13/12.5/12/11.5/11, Eye of Destruction 14/13/12/11/10, Arcanopulse 9s down to 5s at 80-120 mana, Rite of the Arcane 130/115/100.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[0].d now carry explicit 'wait for X before you Y' sequencing with numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cross-layer chart disagreement on all seven rows: every phases[N].side read 'Skill' while win[0..3] read 'Xerath' and win[4..6] read 'Aurora' (matching the packet levelChart). Worse, phases[0..3].why described Aurora winning those very rows.
audit.why: The packet and content agree on Xerath early / Aurora from 6, and the kit supports it (his 1000-1050 ranges beat her 900/700 until the ultimate pins him). The full layer was both stale and self-contradicting.
audit.corrected: All seven sides set to match win[N] as one group, phases[0..3].rating dropped to 4/10, and phases[0..3].why rewritten to state why Xerath owns those rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.wave was the generic Aurora paragraph with no Xerath content.
audit.why: Wave state is the whole early lane here: shoving forces him to spend 80-120 mana Arcanopulses on minions, and a frozen central wave lets Eye of Destruction hit you and the minions together from 1000.

audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed in dosFull[1].d (tradeGood verbatim), dontsFull[1].d (the dontsFull[0] body) and dontsFull[2].d (tradeBad verbatim); dosFull[0].d carried the cooldowns sentence.
audit.corrected: All four rewritten to their own titles.

notes: 1) REAL DEFECT, not a name typo: wants.foe[1] credited Eye of Destruction (W) with stuns. Per Riot's text W only slows; the stun is Shocking Orb (E). The packet flagged this row as a suspect name — the name was fine, the mechanic was wrong. 2) The other flagged suspect, wants.you[2] 'Use Between Worlds', is a FALSE POSITIVE — that is Aurora's real R name. 3) The brief's missingInteractions says Aurora's R 'cancels Rite of the Arcane outright'. I did NOT write that: Riot's text for Aurora's R is a shockwave that damages and slows, with no hard CC, so the hardCC flag looks like a parse misfire. I used the verifiable half instead — Xerath immobilises himself for the channel, so he is a stationary target. 4) I avoided quoting Arcanopulse's range: the kit lists 750, but that is the uncharged figure and I could not verify the charged range from the brief. Every range I did write (W 1000, E 1050, R 5000) is straight from the kit. 5) 'Q Twin Drift' appears again in spikes[0].text and early — unverifiable from the brief, so removed rather than guessed; it recurs across aurora matchups. 6) All seven chart rows disagreed across layers; flipped as one group to the packet/content verdict, with phases[0..3].why rewritten so no row argues with its own sentence.
